rows.transcript_gb_en_m:
Hello! How are you feeling right now? Happy, sad, angry, excited, worried?

Notice where you feel it in your body. Notice what thoughts are connected to that feeling. Take a deep breath.

Thank yourself for taking the time to check in with your feelings and thoughts!
rows.transcript_my_ms_m:
Hai! Bagaimana perasaan anda sekarang? Gembira, sedih, marah, teruja, risau?

Perhatikan dimanakah perasaan itu muncul di tubuh badan anda. Perhatikan juga fikiran yang datang bersama perasaan itu. Tarik nafas dengan dalam dan hembus nafas perlahan-lahan.

Ucapkan terima kasih kepada diri sendiri kerana meluangkan masa untuk menyemak perasaan dan fikiran anda.

text_1_facilitator.eng: Today’s skill is about creating family rules and guidelines with your child.⏰⭐

text_2.eng:

text_1_facilitator.eng: Here’s a quick question for you:

quiz_1_question.eng: True or false: Family rules should be set by the parents because our children are too young to decide for themselves.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng:
❌ That’s incorrect. 

📝 Including children in discussions on family rules help them to feel appreciated and heard.

⏰ They are more likely to follow the rule if they helped to develop the rule.

quiz_1_feedback_2.eng:
⭐ That’s correct! 

📝 Including children in discussions on family rules help them to feel appreciated and heard.

⏰ They are more likely to follow the rule if they helped to develop the rule.

quiz_2_question.eng:
Setting limits is also important for children. What do you think about this one?
Setting limits through household rules, daily routines, and healthy living is bad for your child because you are not allowing them to think on their own.

quiz_2_feedback_1.eng:
❌ Incorrect. 

💚 When you set reasonable limits with your child, you are not controlling your child too much. 

🌷 You are giving your child structure to maintain a positive parent-child relationship and explore the world safely.

🧸 Setting reasonable limits with your child is a good form of positive discipline.

quiz_2_feedback_2.eng:
⭐ You are right! 

💚 Setting reasonable limits with your child is a good form of positive discipline. 

🧸 You are not controlling your child too much. 

🌷 You are giving your child structure to maintain a positive parent-child relationship and explore the world safely.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 4️⃣ Here are four easy tips to help you make family rules with your child:

section_1_text.eng:
📝 Create rules with your child. You can write these down or use pictures when needed to help your Child understand.
⏸ Make one rule at a time.
🔑 Talk about why the rule is important.
👂 Listen to what your child thinks too.

section_2_text.eng:
⭐ Be realistic: make rules that your child can actually do.
📖 Be clear and specific about what you want.
✅ Make sure the rule is fair and explain why it is needed.

section_3_text.eng:
🔄 Stick to the rule once it has been set. 
⬆️ Your child will be more likely to follow the rule.
▶️ If the rule includes you, it is important that you stick to it too.

section_4_text.eng:
⭐ Praise your child for helping make the rule. 
😃 Praise your child when they follow the rule, just like you do when they behave well!
